observation: The title requires gu under the proposed reading. hus and lus both yield gu in v4; compare lus at s2t140. The first letter/vowel are not sufficiently clear to elect a new transcription.
First domus formula: short initial minim currently reads ib=mi. ub=mu is contextual; shape not decisively settled.
Rounded 2/z-like sign. Matching Z=u would still leave the noun unresolved; retained separately.
Extra initial tall stroke and unclear final group; do not replace with su to manufacture ausus.
Same broad 2/z shape as s1t008, but quos would require a different reading or missing o. This constrains the proposed relative clause.
An e-valued loop is visibly present. Omitting it to make coniecerint is an editorial deletion, not a confirmed transcription correction.
Additional ru-valued group appears present. Nearby overlapping descenders complicate diacritics; no null marker securely established.
Looped ascender after a short initial stroke resembles ib; no independent proof of the vowel. Compare L2-00b with ib in L2-02a.
The intermissurum candidate needs tun=ru. Image still resembles tin, including an apparent dot; retain tin.
ten looks e-like in source; intended minoris needs tin. Retain observed ten, mark editorial e/i change.
Source e-like vowel retained; Dilectionis needs i. Context alone is insufficient to change the transcript.
quas versus intended quam/other comparative construction is not resolved by the shape.
Leading stroke in 146 retained; v4 gives both 146 and 46 pa. This does not independently support regrouping 10 8 as 108.
The z-like sign remains visible inside quautum. Replacing u by n to obtain quantum is editorial.
Short upright t without the long below-baseline loop seen in fus at P2.C16; compare L2-06a and L2-16a. The remaining 10 8 10 is retained as three tokens.
10 and 8 have appreciable spacing; no repeated 108 token. Merging requires a separate hypothesis.
Digit 8 retained independently. 108=b is not in the recovered key.
Separate sharp/crossed-double-t is visible between hi and G; L2-06b. Omitted from pass2. Established value s.
hes is visually legible and v4 gives ge. Intended intendere would require de, a different frame value, or a redundant final s in the cipher group. Not silently repaired.
Short crossed f shape, not the section-sign curl used for S. Both already have value t; L2-10b.
Triangle n-sign visible; illorun is not silently changed to illorum.
Horizontal barred oval without the long descending stem of G; L2-12b and right page edge. Separate shape; value not assigned in the conservative decode.

After fir, an additional p-initial group is clipped by the dark right border. The p descender and following strokes are visible in L2-12b and the uncropped rotated page. pin=li is a completion, not a fully visible group. Counted as one provisional group.
Tall looped second ascender is compatible with b, unlike the compact 6 of 16 at the end of the preceding line. Compare L2-13a with L2-12b. The reading mihi supports but does not prove this choice.
Barred loop with long descender and lower cross-stroke resembles the G immediately later in L2-13b and the haud sign on p3. It differs from the small e-under-oval compound at s2t086.
Diacritic position/identity not securely resolved; v4 assigns m contextually. Retain this compound label.
Barred two-letter group; vowel and value uncertain. Kept as a compound instead of importing ad=na.
Compound h-like sign with superscript marks; value not recovered.
A small e-like component below the barred oval, not the long descending G form; L2-15b. Compound value remains unknown.
xir appears in the source; intended motu requires xur. Retain source and record i/u emendation.
Crossed a-like sign is visible; intended commune needs u instead of its established i. No source-supported substitution elected.
cal=que is inherited from context in v4, not established as an ordinary vowel-preserving family.
Tall loop and preceding short stroke are ambiguous; pass2 ub=mu retained, but source may be ib. No confidence upgrade from domus context.
Long-stem 4 after comuodu remains; m needed for commodum is not justified by setting all 4 signs to m.
Triangular 4-like shape has a much shorter lower stem than adjacent ordinary 4 signs; L2-20a versus L2-19b. Candidate n in non is contextual and is not installed as a key value.
C=l is visible. The edited ea requires changing its value to a at this occurrence; keep discrepancy explicit.
